entries.title: Psalms 150:1
segments: ¶Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to God in his holy place: give him praise in the heaven of his power.

entries.title: Psalms 150:2
segments: Give him praise for his acts of power: give him praise in the measure of his great strength.

entries.title: Psalms 150:3
segments: Give him praise with the sound of the horn: give him praise with corded instruments of music.

entries.title: Psalms 150:4
segments: Give him praise with instruments of brass and in the dance: give him praise with horns and corded instruments.

entries.title: Psalms 150:5
segments: Give him praise with the loud brass: give him praise with the high-sounding brass.

entries.title: Psalms 150:6
segments: Let everything which has breath give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised.
